name: Kitsu API
summary: JSON:API for anime and manga: titles, ratings, episodes, characters, streaming links, categories and trending lists.
description: Kitsu's public edge API serves anime, manga, episodes, characters, categories, mappings to other sites (MyAnimeList, AniList, TheTVDB ids), streaming links and trending lists as JSON:API documents, with sparse fieldsets, filters, sorting and includes. Reading the catalogue needs no authentication; user libraries and writes use OAuth.

auth.notes: Catalogue reads worked without credentials; user-specific data and writes need OAuth (not tested).

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: List or search anime; filter[text], filter[categories], sort, include
One anime; include=episodes, characters, genres and more

license.name: Not stated on the docs pages fetched

coverage.temporal: Community edited in real time; records updated as recently as today at check

agent_notes: Use sparse fieldsets (fields[anime]=...) because full anime objects are large (image variants, rating histograms). Send page[limit] up to 20 and follow links.next. In curl, quote or percent-encode the bracket parameters (or use -g). Use /mappings?filter[externalSite]=myanimelist/anime to translate ids.
caveats: page[limit] above 20 returns HTTP 400 ('Limit exceeds maximum page size of 20').
Responses are application/vnd.api+json; relationships appear as links unless you request include.
No usage license or rate limit was found in the docs pages fetched.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials.
